eyebrow: SQL for Oracle Financials · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 15 · Aggregation and Aging

code:
SELECT vendor_id, check_date, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (
           PARTITION BY vendor_id
           ORDER BY check_date
       ) AS running_total
FROM ap_checks_all
ORDER BY vendor_id, check_date;
caption: OVER() computes a sum per row, over a window of other rows — nothing collapses.
The largest invoice per supplier gets row number 1.
